top_signals.title: Germany’s Power Grid Could Be NATO’s Weakest Link
top_signals.summary: If Russia attacks a NATO member, Germany would have six months to move as many as 800,000 allied troops and 200,000 vehicles across the country toward the eastern flank. The ports, airports and railways required for that movement already carry military equipment through Europe and toward Ukraine. Germany says Russia attempted to bomb a Ukrainian cargo aircraft at Leipzig/Halle Airport, which houses NATO’s heavy-airlift program. top_signals.title: FBI Probes Service Selling 153M+ Drivers Licenses
top_signals.summary: A new identity theft service launched on the dark web this week is selling digital scans of more than 153 million drivers licenses from people in the United States and Canada. Based on interviews with individuals whose licenses are available for purchase on this service, it appears to be siphoning images collected by a widely-used identity verification company based in Louisiana. KrebsOnSecurity also has learned that the New Orleans field office of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) today launched an official inquiry into the source of the images.
